## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Mecklenburg-Vorpommern lights up on the map of Germany.
> Mecklenburg-Vorpommern | Landeshauptstadt Schwerin

[dramatic] [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]], Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, lies on the Baltic coast, in the north-east. It has islands like Rügen, and hundreds of lakes. Its capital is Schwerin; its biggest city is Rostock.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> MECKLENBURG-VORPOMMERN

## On the map

{Q378}

> SCENE (question): Question card #378. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?]] Which federal state is Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[3]]. Number three: the north-east, along the Baltic coast.


{Q377}

> SCENE (question): Question card #377. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Mecklenburg-Vorpommern heißt …]] The state capital of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern is …

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Schwerin.]] The other three are real cities in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q375}

> SCENE (question): Question card #375. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[blau-weiß-gelb-rot]]. Blue, white, yellow and red: four colours, from its two old regions.


{Q371}

> SCENE (question): Question card #371. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the federal state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 3]], picture three: a black bull’s head and a red griffin.


## How it's run

{Q372}

> SCENE (question): Question card #372. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?]] Which of these is a district in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Mecklenburgische Seenplatte]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Prignitz]] is in [[Brandenburg]], [[Vogtlandkreis]] is in [[Sachsen]], and [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]] is in [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]].


{Q373}

> SCENE (question): Question card #373. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q374}

> SCENE (question): Question card #374. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q379}

> SCENE (question): Question card #379. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?]] What is the title of the head of government in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q380}

> SCENE (question): Question card #380. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Mecklenburg-Vorpommern nicht?]] Which minister does Mecklenburg-Vorpommern not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q376}

> SCENE (question): Question card #376. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political issues in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam
